description:
In today’s dynamic environment, business leaders face constantly shifting risks. Riveron helps organizations implement leading governance, risk and compliance practices by combining deep expertise with pragmatic partnership, using a hands-on approach to understand the specific needs of the organization and create tailored solutions to address key compliance risks.

 

Riveron’s October 2025 acquisition of Eden Data significantly expands the scope and depth of its Risk Advisory solutions, adding world-class expertise in cybersecurity, governance, risk, compliance (GRC), and AI.

 

Our Cyber Security Advisory (CSA) services include building GRC/Cybersecurity programs from the ground up, framework readiness, design and maintenance of critical security domains, managed internal controls testing and monitoring, co-sourced/outsourced internal audit, segregation of duties and access risk review, policy and procedure development, enterprise risk management, and IT and cybersecurity risk assessment.

Our team of experts, hailing from “Big 4” consultancies, is dedicated to delivering tailored services that help our clients navigate complex compliance standards and achieve robust security postures. We believe in honesty, simplicity, and a performance-driven model that benefits our clients and builds long-term trust.

About The Role:

We are seeking a dynamic Account Executive to join our team. This role is focused on new customers within our GRC partner referrals and blends sales responsibilities with customer experience to ensure that our clients have a seamless journey throughout their lifecycle. The ideal candidate will be proactive, consultative, and skilled at identifying, qualifying and pursuing sales opportunities with new customers.

What You'll Do:

1. Sales & Business Development:

  • Identify and qualify opportunities among GRC partner referred customers, understanding their needs and aligning them with our ongoing services.

  • Lead consultative discovery conversations, confidently challenging customer assumptions, identifying gaps in their security and compliance strategies, and recommending solutions based on business objectives rather than simply responding to stated requests.

  • Build proposals and Statements of Work for customers, articulating the value of our services and solutions.

  • Perform general sales development responsibilities, including maintaining forecasts, hitting performance metrics, lead qualification and pipeline management.

  • Be responsive to customer inquiries, following up appropriately to close deals.

  • Collaborate with sales, delivery and legal to ensure a smooth sales process for all identified opportunities.

2. Administration & CRM Management:

  • Maintain CRM hygiene by ensuring that all customer interactions, notes, and project updates are accurately recorded.

  • Track sales opportunities, and follow-ups in the CRM system.

  • Support delivery functions in on project status, sales progress, and customer feedback to relevant stakeholders.

  • Implement best practices and streamline workflows to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.

3. Project Delivery & Management:

  • Leverage and participate in project kickoff calls with GRC customers to identify opportunities and convert into practice offerings.

  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and timely project execution.

  • Act as the primary point of contact for customers during the CAP, providing regular updates and addressing any concerns.

What You Have:

  • Demonstrated technical aptitude and working knowledge of cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, and GRC frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, etc.). Ability to independently navigate technical discovery conversations, ask informed questions, and translate complex requirements into practical recommendations.

  • Strong negotiation and objection handling skills for contract discussions and supporting our legal team

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships with customers and internal teams.

  • Bring a growth mindset focused on helping new customers

  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

  • Proficient in CRM software and project management tools. SFDC experience is a plus.

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team, with a proactive and results-driven approach.

About Riveron:

At Riveron, we partner with clients—from global multinationals to high-growth private entities—to solve complex finance challenges, guided by our DELTA values: Drive, Excellence, Leadership, Teamwork, and Accountability. Our entrepreneurial culture thrives on collaboration, diverse perspectives, and delivering exceptional outcomes. We are committed to fostering growth, both for our clients and our people, through mentorship, integrity, and a client-centric approach. This inclusive environment offers flexibility, progressive benefits, and meaningful opportunities for impactful work that supports well-being in and out of the office.

Want to stay connected with Riveron? Join our Talent Community to learn more about our growing firm and be considered for future opportunities.

Fraud Alert

Please beware of fraudulent schemes or impersonations when going through the job application process. A Riveron employee will never recruit via text or extend unsolicited employment offers. Additionally, a Riveron employee will never ask you to exchange money or purchase anything as part of the recruiting process.

Artificial intelligence (AI) tools are used to support the hiring process in screening, assessing, and/or selecting applicants for this position. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
